# The plans of the queries on the schema goqite_index, which TestAccessOf_golden in access_test.go checks.
# Rewrite with: go test ./internal/engine -run TestAccessOf_golden -update

create table goqite (id text primary key, created text not null, updated text not null, queue text not null, body blob not null, timeout text not null, received int not null, priority int not null) strict, without rowid
create index goqite_queue_priority_created_idx on goqite (queue, priority desc, created)

## receive in order
select id from goqite where queue = ? and timeout <= ? and received < ? order by priority desc, created limit 1
args: 'default', '2026-11-20T12:00:00.000Z', 3
access: index goqite_queue_priority_created_idx (queue, priority desc, created, id), pins queue = 'default'
order: delivered, forward

## receive in order as goqite writes it
select id from goqite where queue = ? and ? >= timeout and received < ? order by priority desc, created limit 1
args: 'default', '2026-11-20T12:00:00.000Z', 3
access: index goqite_queue_priority_created_idx (queue, priority desc, created, id), pins queue = 'default'
order: delivered, forward

## receive in order without a limit
select id from goqite where queue = ? and ? >= timeout and received < ? order by priority desc, created
args: 'default', '2026-11-20T12:00:00.000Z', 3
access: index goqite_queue_priority_created_idx (queue, priority desc, created, id), pins queue = 'default'
order: delivered, forward

## receive
select id from goqite where queue = ? and timeout <= ? and received < ?
args: 'default', '2026-11-20T12:00:00.000Z', 3
access: index goqite_queue_priority_created_idx (queue, priority desc, created, id), pins queue = 'default'

## receive as goqite writes it
select id from goqite where queue = ? and ? >= timeout and received < ?
args: 'default', '2026-11-20T12:00:00.000Z', 3
access: index goqite_queue_priority_created_idx (queue, priority desc, created, id), pins queue = 'default'

## by id
select body from goqite where id = ?
args: 'm_0001'
access: get, id = 'm_0001'

## by queue
select id from goqite where queue = 'default'
access: index goqite_queue_priority_created_idx (queue, priority desc, created, id), pins queue = 'default'

## by queue and priority
select id from goqite where queue = ? and priority = ?
args: 'default', 1
access: index goqite_queue_priority_created_idx (queue, priority desc, created, id), pins queue = 'default', priority = 1

## by queue and a range of priorities
select id from goqite where queue = 'default' and priority >= 1 and priority < 3
access: index goqite_queue_priority_created_idx (queue, priority desc, created, id), pins queue = 'default', bounds 1 <= priority < 3

## extend
update goqite set timeout = ? where queue = ? and id = ?
args: '2026-11-20T12:05:00.000Z', 'default', 'm_0001'
access: get, id = 'm_0001'

## delete
delete from goqite where queue = ? and id = ?
args: 'default', 'm_0001'
access: get, id = 'm_0001'

## delete a queue
delete from goqite where queue = 'default'
access: index goqite_queue_priority_created_idx (queue, priority desc, created, id), pins queue = 'default'

## receive by id
update goqite set timeout = ?, received = ? where id = ? returning id, body
args: '2026-11-20T12:00:30.000Z', 1, 'm_0001'
access: get, id = 'm_0001'

## delete a queue with RETURNING
delete from goqite where queue = ? returning id
args: 'default'
access: index goqite_queue_priority_created_idx (queue, priority desc, created, id), pins queue = 'default'
